title: Jeweled Mask
description: At the start of each combat, put a random Power from your [gold]Draw Pile[/gold] into your [gold]Hand[/gold]. It's free to play this combat.
flavor: [red]Details for this relic will be revealed in the future...[/red]
notes: Triggers before hand draw on turn 1. Selects a random Power card from your draw pile and makes it free to play that turn.
